description: This file contains a single exported function `shapeAgentGroupedSeries` that processes an array of records to produce a dataset suitable for charting or visualization, specifically for aggregating costs by agent and categorizing them with optional grouping by environment or cost category.

methods.name: shapeAgentGroupedSeries(records, groupBy = "environment", options)
methods.description: Transforms raw aggregate records into a grouped dataset suitable for visualization, ensuring consistent categories across all agents and optionally sorting by agent and category.
